metadata.description: Name of the the environment which is used to generate a short unique hash used in all resources.
Email address for PostgreSQL control-plane alert notifications. Leave empty to skip alert deployment.
Policy effect for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server owner-tag governance policy. Use Deny to block untagged servers at creation, Audit to log only.
Environment name used to scope the policy assignment and RBAC role assignable scopes.
Policy effect applied to the PostgreSQL Flexible Server governance policy. Deny blocks new servers missing the required tag; Audit only logs; Disabled turns the policy off.

properties.description: Provides management access to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Servers but explicitly removes the stop and start actions to prevent user-initiated downtime. Assign to production operators instead of Contributor.

properties.displayName: PostgreSQL Flexible Servers must have an owner tag
properties.description: Ensures every PostgreSQL Flexible Server carries an owner tag so that access-review processes can identify who authorised the resource and contact them when control-plane events like stop/start occur.

metadata.description: Deny blocks resources missing the tag; Audit logs them; Disabled turns the policy off.

properties.description: [format('Blocks or audits PostgreSQL Flexible Servers without an owner tag in the {0} environment.', parameters('environmentName'))]

metadata.description: Email address to notify when a PostgreSQL stop or start action is detected

properties.description: Fires when a PostgreSQL flexible server stop/action is accepted on the subscription. Pages on-call immediately with actor identity.
Fires when a PostgreSQL flexible server start/action is accepted on the subscription. Used to correlate recovery events with prior stop incidents.
